叶清秋渡劫绝对非常的壮观，远处的战场都被这变故弄得喊了中场休息，不少人往雷劫的地方飞，想看看谁在渡劫。

到了地方却只看到一黑一白的两道人影，站在树尖上，渡劫之人却是没看到。

但是那手臂粗的紫雷一道接一道的劈下，证明渡劫的人是在这里的。

魔族的人来得较慢，来的却是魔君，他一眼就看到格外醒目的两人，目光闪了闪，飞身落到时笙旁边的一颗树冠上。

时笙看了他一眼就收回了视线，倒是凤辞，有些跃跃欲试的想要放火烧君无期。

时笙没开口，凤辞也只能心底想想，或则琢磨等时笙看不到的时候动手。

“商姑娘，不知有没有兴趣加入我魔界？”

时笙又将视线转回君无期身上，若有所思的道：“魔君是看上我哪里了？”

她当初和魔君的条件很简单，他以后若是遇到叶清秋，不可伸援助之手。

按理说，他们已经钱货两清，就算君无期毁约，对时笙也没多大影响，不过是多个敌人罢了。

这君无期怎么忽然邀请她加入魔界了？

脑子被劈了？

“商姑娘很厉害。”君无期这声赞赏没有任何掺假。

他特意查过她的来历，四百年前缥缈宗天尽峰的弟子，后来脱离缥缈宗，在修真界十年，名声盛大，人人喊诛，之后不知何缘故失踪，最后却是出现在魔界。

最重要的是，她的修为，至少在大乘……

这样一个人，他有什么理由不邀请她加入魔界？

“我也知道我很厉害，然后呢？”

“……”你这么不谦虚，完全没法聊好不好！君无期掩饰性的咳嗽了一下，“商姑娘若是加入魔界，我许你一人之下万人之上如何？”

一人之下万人之上？啧啧，这魔君也是下血本了啊！

这是看上本宝宝哪里了？美貌？能力？

一定是美貌，女配的容貌那都是一等一的，就是为了来映衬那句蛇蝎美人，所以商殊的容貌绝对是不差的。

没想到魔君竟然是这样的魔君。

时笙脑补完，调整了下面部表情，一本正经的道：“魔君，多谢你的抬爱，不过我对一人之下万人之上没有兴趣。”

她顿了顿，突然咧嘴笑了起来，“我的目标是星辰大海……咳……是仙界的那个位置。”

君无期听完前半句以为她是那种不喜约束的人，谁知道她下一秒就甩出这么一句，君无期身子一歪，差点从树冠上掉下去。

这女人好大的口气！

张口就是仙界的那个位置，比他还狂妄。

不过……

他喜欢！

“想必以后我们应该会有合作的机会。”君无期笑得意味深长。

时笙眨巴下眼，和君无期合作？

这个男人城府老深了，本宝宝才不和这种整天阴谋阳谋的人待一块，指不定什么时候就被吃了，还是不吐骨头的那种。

时笙含糊的应了一声，君无期假装没看出她的敷衍，留下让她有事可以找他的话，然后回到了魔族的地盘。

Ye Qingqiu's tribulation was absolutely spectacular. The battlefield in the distance was called an intermission due to this unexpected incident. Many people flew to the place where the tribulation was, wanting to see who was going through the tribulation.

When they arrived at the place, they only saw two figures, one black and one white, standing on the top of the tree, but the man who had overcome the tribulation did not see them.

But the purple thunder with thick arms struck down one after another, proving that the person who had overcome the tribulation was here.

The demons came slower, but it was the Demon Lord who came. He saw the two particularly eye-catching people at a glance, his eyes flashed, and he flew to the crown of a tree next to Shi Sheng.

Shi Sheng glanced at him and looked away, but Feng Ci was a little eager to set fire to Jun Wuqi.

Shi Sheng didn't speak, so Feng Ci could only think about it in his heart, or think about taking action when Shi Sheng couldn't see.

"Miss Shang, are you interested in joining my demon world?"

Shi Sheng turned his gaze back to Jun Wuqi and said thoughtfully: "What did the Demon Lord see in me?"

Her original condition with the Demon Lord was very simple. If he met Ye Qingqiu in the future, he would not lend a helping hand.

It stands to reason that they have already cleared their money and goods, so even if Jun Wuqi breaks the contract, it will not have much impact on Shi Sheng, they are just multiple enemies.

Why did Jun Wuqi suddenly invite her to join the demon world?

Got your brain hacked?

"Miss Shang is amazing." Jun Wuqi's praise was without any deception.

He specifically checked her origins. She was a disciple of the Piaomiao Sect Tianju Peak four hundred years ago. Later, she left the Piaomiao Sect. She gained a great reputation in the world of cultivation for ten years and everyone called for her death. Then she disappeared for unknown reasons and finally appeared in the demon world.

The most important thing is that her cultivation level, at least in Mahayana...

For such a person, what reason would he have for not inviting her to join the demon world?

"I also know that I am very powerful, but what next?"

"..." You are so immodest, you can't talk at all, okay?Jun Wuqi coughed covertly, "If Miss Shang joins the demon world, how about I promise you that one person is better than ten thousand people?"

One person is inferior to ten thousand people?Tsk tsk, this demon king is also spending a lot of money!

Where do you see this baby?Beauty?ability?

It must be beauty. The appearance of the female partner is first-class, just to set off the femme fatale, so Shang Shu's appearance is definitely not bad.

I didn’t expect the Demon Lord to be such a Demon Lord.

Shi Sheng finished thinking, adjusted his facial expression, and said seriously: "Demon Lord, thank you for your compliments, but I am not interested in one person being inferior to ten thousand people."

She paused and suddenly grinned, "My goal is the sea of stars... ahem... the location in the fairy world."

After hearing the first half of the sentence, Jun Wuqi thought she was the kind of person who doesn't like to be restrained. Who knew that she would throw out such a sentence the next second? Jun Wuqi tilted his body and almost fell from the tree crown.

This woman has such a loud voice!

He was even more arrogant than him when he opened his mouth and was in that position in the fairy world.

But...

He likes it!

"I think we should have opportunities to cooperate in the future." Jun Wuqi smiled meaningfully.

Shi Sheng blinked, and there was no hope of cooperating with Jun?

This man is very old, and I don't want to be with someone like this who plots and plots all day long. He might be eaten at any time without spitting out his bones.

Shi Sheng responded vaguely, and Jun Wuqi pretended not to see how perfunctory she was, leaving a message asking her to come to him if she had anything to do, and then returned to the territory of the demon clan.
